svg.title: Yellow Black
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study from the actual primary auction photograph. Approximate geometry, interpretive palette; photographic shadows, frame and texture omitted. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of yellow; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
